libs.note: BH-1940. The bounds on lane_day_usd's read of logs/cost.csv. Resolved by _lc_knobs through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then from this file's own default in the checkout. COST, LANE_CAPS_DAY and LANE_CAPS_CONF are a path, a test seam and a test hook, not config, and are not registered.

knobs.note: How many rows at the end of cost.csv one lane_day_usd call reads. The lane log says so when the window may start inside the day. Read by bin/lib/lane-caps.sh with no literal since BH-1940; was ${LANE_CAPS_SCAN:-4000}.

How many rows with tokens and no dollars one call prices (one jq call each). Past it the lane log says the day total reads low. Read by bin/lib/lane-caps.sh with no literal since BH-1940; was ${LANE_CAPS_PRICE_MAX:-500}.
